title: IPCC AR6: since 1750, CO2 is up 47 percent and methane 156 percent
summary: The same A.2.1 paragraph gives those percentage increases and compares them with glacial-to-interglacial changes.
body: IPCC Working Group I statement A.2.1 says that since 1750, increases in CO2 of 47 percent and in methane of 156 percent far exceed, and the increase in nitrous oxide of 23 percent is similar to, the natural multi-millennial changes between glacial and interglacial periods over at least the past 800,000 years. It marks that comparison very high confidence. The percentages are the summary's, measured from 1750 to the report's 2019 concentrations.
